reviews.text: My 3 cats are customers at Poplar Vet and I could not be happier. Fantastic service, easy to book and can get emergency appointment.  Absolutely recommended!
Rima was very helpful sorting out my cats medication, at poplar vets. As always, easy contact and communication, and great customer service. Thanks Rima!
Been amazing with my Milo from pup all staff have been amazing and polite and professional best vet I’ve been to
Very good customer service

Very pleased to have joined Poplar Vets at Wood Wharf.
From easy and convenient online sign up, to a friendly welcome (and goodbye) at reception and a really helpful and informative consultation with Dr Bernie about Librella and general health tips for my 11 yo dog - highly recommended.
Amazing vet, quick service and lovely staff. If you need neutering they give appointments with in a week. Highly recommend. If you are on benefits the discount is worth it.

I was disappointed with the service I received from the reception staff at Poplar Vets. They are not friendly.

When booking my puppy’s second vaccination, I noticed that the appointment had been scheduled only three weeks after his first vaccination, while his vaccination record clearly stated that the next dose should be given four weeks later. I contacted reception in advance and asked them to check and reschedule it, but they were dismissive and insisted that the timing had been recommended by the vet. When I arrived for the appointment, the vet checked the vaccination record and immediately told me it was too early and that the vaccine could not be given, so the trip could have been avoided if my concern had been properly checked beforehand.

Really lovely vet practice. The staff are incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely happy to help. They made me feel reassured and took great care of my cats. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy vet.

Such an amazing practice, they have always been so accommodating for my pets, special thanks to Becky, Karene and Gemma for helping me out over the last few days. I can’t say how much I love this practice and all the staff that work there. I appreciate you all so much and I don’t think I can thank you as much.
The service was really good and they treated my kitten carefully

I can't thank Charlene at Poplar Vets enough for the care and compassion she has shown both me and my cat.

From the very beginning, she was incredibly kind, patient, and understanding. She never made me feel like I was being fobbed off or rushed to someone else. Instead, she genuinely listened to my concerns, took the time to hear me out, and made me feel supported every step of the way.

What meant the most was how understanding she was when I was struggling financially. Rather than making me feel judged or helpless, she went out of her way to find an alternative route that would give me peace of mind. I'll never forget her saying, *"The main thing is we get your cat seen."* Those words meant so much to me and showed just how much she truly cares about the wellbeing of both animals and their owners.

The service and care Charlene provides are beyond amazing. She is professional, compassionate, and genuinely one of the kindest people I've met. She has a wonderful way with both customers and their pets, and it's clear that she does this job because she truly cares.

Thank you, Charlene, for everything you've done. You're an absolute credit to Poplar Vets, and I couldn't recommend you highly enough.
Professional checkup of cat. Very quick and simple to do

This vet was lovely and clean with Air con so nice and cool for our new puppy. Big thank you to Bec on reception who managed to get us an appointment quickly. She was friendly professional and offered the best advice. Also a big thank you to Louie who examined and handled our new puppy with so much care whilst giving him his first vaccination. Great service all round.
They have been very nice to all my pets.

Recently, my dog had dental surgery at this vet clinic, and everything went smoothly. I was very happy with the service. The vet, nurses, and the entire team were incredibly supportive, gentle, kind, and professional throughout the whole process.
I would especially like to thank Becky, the nurse, who was always available to help and support us during Harley’s recovery. Her kindness, care, and reassurance made a real difference. Thank you all for taking such wonderful care of Harley. I highly recommend this clinic

Have been back and forth with loaf for numerous issues the last few months. At very stressful times the staff and vets have been helpful and wonderful always providing answers and support. Thank you Charlene and Liberty for you help 🙏 …

Louie took great care of my cat and quickly identified the issue. He was professional, caring, and resolved the problem promptly. I’m very grateful for his help and would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and compassionate vet.
Charlene and the team are always incredibly helpful and our dog has received great care and love every time we’ve been in!
Very lovely and friendly staff Charlene, Becky Rima and liberty. and great with pets. They go above and behond.

Simply Amazing!

Have had the best experience so far with Poplar Vet. The team has been amazing, especially Charlene! Very accommodating and informative lovely lady.

We will definitely return to Poplar Vets.

Many thanks,

Bela

Shout out to Becky who helped us tremendously on the insurance claims. My cat went for a dental hygiene session and got diagnosed with kidney disease as well as two teeth needed to be pulled. Insurance rejected us because we just switched to a new insurance less than 14 days…
Becky went out of her way and helped us to file the claim. I am more than thankful for what Becky did for us. The medical bill was quite a bit and being able to have the professional help from Becky on the insurance claim was super helpful!

Very professional practice, always happy to help and give multiple ways and budgets for pet care.
Becky on reception is always willing to help nothing is too much for her such a kind person.

Vet and staff were friendly, but I felt things weren’t explained well. Took my cat in for a dental consult regarding a wobbly tooth, then walked out being quoted over £1k for operations and unrelated procedures I did not request. I took my cat to Veteris 6 months ago for bloods, dental X-rays and a general check up - nothing of which was highlighted then.

Was told my cats tooth would likely fall out by itself, but then told it was also an emergency that needed to be sorted asap. Confusing advice and a lack of explanation made the service more stressful - I’m sure the practice has the best intentions but I feel like I wasn’t listened to much.

I think they should also make it clear that their pet plan doesn’t take out payment immediately and therefore can’t cover services if used immediately. I understand the idea behind people using it then cancelling, but they are very clear about that charging services at normal rate. It seems to be a redundant argument as they would have got full payment either way?

We have been bringing our dog to Poplar vets since she was a puppy, and in recent years since the opening of Wood Wharf, she's been going to this branch. The team here always take exceptionally good care of her. It's clear that everyone cares about the animals and want to do their best to help.

I had the pleasure of visiting Poplar Vets for the first time with my new Kitten on 15/06/26. First of all, the receptionist was very kind and friendly. It was extremely quick to check in! Secondly, the vet called Louie was amazing. He conducted a full check of my kitten and also spent time explaining what he was doing. Very bright and friendly atmosphere in Poplar Vets. I’d like to thank all the staff for their hard work.

Excellent care for my dog’s BOAS surgery!

I brought my 1-year-old Frenchie to Poplar Vets for BOAS surgery and couldn’t be happier. Dr Marek was outstanding, knowledgeable and reassuring. He explained very clearly the whole procedure to me. Practice manager Tomas was attentive and professional who proactively checked on my dog several times post-surgery. The receptionists were wonderfully kind and responsive throughout the process.

My dog is now home recovering comfortably. I highly recommend Poplar Vets to any brachycephalic owner considering this surgery. The entire team is passionate, communicative, and provides top-tier care.

Was very grateful to have been recommended this Vet by another Vet who was unable to assist my urgent situation. And I'm writing this review specifically for Dr Alessandro Iuculano. I cannot thank him enough for how he helped me as I discovered my fur baby (Bow) was not going to be able to make it. He went above and beyond not just for her specific situation and helping her transition without any pain, he also was there for me. This is so rare to find. And I hope this review will not make him inundated with too many new requests. But he is truly a rare gem and I am so grateful to have found him at such a critical moment. Thank you Dr Alessandro! Poplar Vet in general are very professional and compassionate, and no crazy unnecessary  hidden costs! I esp prefer the Wood Wharf location but the one in Poplar is also good. Highly recommend them.

The vets themselves are great. You can get an appointment fast enough, however sometimes they are too busy thus you need to wait a long time. The front desk staff seems quite unfriendly, one of them cannot speak English so well either.
I have my 3 pets register on this vet and every time I go they are wonderful, I even recommend my sister who also now has register her 2 pets.

I just wanted to say a massive Thankyou to all the staff at poplar vets for hooking me up with a appoitment last minute. I bought a puppy from out of London and he had a vanguard vaccine  injection done and we had to vaccinate him for a second injection and vanguard is no longer as popular as it use to be in London and it was so hard to find anyone who could help us with a vanguard vaccination also it was the last chance to do it. Next day otherwise the fist vaccine would expire and this would mean we have to start again and it would effect our puppy we wouldn’t  be able to bring him out for many weeks but thanks to poplar vets we sorted a last minute appointment the next day.
the team looked after us and gave our puppy the vaccine what was required and answered all our questions. I highly recommend anyone who needs a vet for a vanguard vaccination or a vet in general to go to poplar vets they are caring people and really want to help you and your pet to give your pet the best possible outcome. The vaccine went so smooth the puppy slept through both injections. The team took away our stress and anxiety thanks to poplar vets we can take our puppy outside in the next 2 weeks rather than wait 6 weeks and start again. THANKYOU so much to all the grate staff memebers, they are grate individuals who highly care about animals and love them to bits and give grate information and correct information and treat you very well and make you feel comfortable and happy.

I have used this vets twice and both times they were good. The second time I was in a real jam and they were amazing. They really helped me out at super short notice. The reception team were incredibly helpful and very friendly. The vet was thorough and gave us all the time we needed. I would 100% recommend Poplar Vets.
Highest recommendations.

Took my dog for yearly booster the appointment was incorrectly booked by a receptionist but I was still seen the vet was very polite and kind gave my dog a good check over and gave good advise for after care from injection Bert was happy and so am i

Couldn’t rate this place enough! They have been absolutely amazing in every respect: communication, professionalism, friendliness, reassurance all 5*!
You can honestly tell that this practice do what they do out of a genuine care and passion for animals and not solely for the money. I hate having to leave my cats especially for surgery or treatment, naturally I worry! But everyone at this practice from the receptionists, vets and nurses to the leadership, have been so lovely and reassuring, and genuinely lovely to my cats.
Can’t praise this place enough! If you want a group of people who you can genuinely trust with your precious pets, go here.

Five shiny stars to dr Gean, nurse Amy, all doctors, nurses and receptionists for your care, professionalism and compassion extended to my foster cat Ollie. Ollie crossed the rainbow bridge today after 6 weeks in my care, having been captured as a stray in very poor state, with advanced kidney disease and FIV. He was a frequent visitor to both branches on Poplar Vets and was always charmed by ladies there. I’d like to highlight that this lovely clinic looked after Ollie, a poor elderly London stray tabby, like he was a pedigree feline of the highest class. Thank you for all you did for him and others.

Great experience and very helpful for my 3 month old kitten little legs and jay was very helpful and kind and very happy. Charlene was very helpful at reception and kind. Would recommend for everyone to come here great service :)

Very good experience
the staff is very helpful thank you
Explain things very well.
Thank you very much.
Maria was nice to our kitten and explained everything thoroughly, the package price very reasonable for the first timer and we loved it

I've been really impressed by the level of care and support given to both my pets and me at every encounter I've had with vets, nurses and staff at Poplar Vets.
In my experience, it's an excellent practice and I cant recommend them highly enough.

I have gone to this clinic several times over the last couple of years with my cats. I have had nothing but good experiences every single time! The receptionists always treat me with respect and answer all of my questions. Every vet and nurse has treated my cats with care, regardless if I have come in for a regular vaccination or for a life threatening emergency. I cannot thank every member of staff enough for how they approach customer service and treatment, and I cannot recommend this clinic enough!

I want to specifically say thank you to Dr Jae Won Jun, Dr Eleanor Sarah Curtis, Dr May Hsu Ko, Dr Kostas Katsarakis and Dr Liliana Pierfelice, who have all provided superb care for my cats!
Co operative friendly staff
Helped me really good and very quick good accommodation

I recently swicthed to Wood wharf vets and i'm so glad did. The front desk staff was welcoming and facility in top-notch. I did an appointment for my cat with Liberty she was very kind and explained everything.  The Doctor Liliana is absolutley fantastic Vet. She is very professional and truly care about my Ginger cat. Ginger had a infection on the skin ,high fever and she prescribed a treatment with antibiotics and anti inflamatory. Ginger is much better and recovering his health again.
Congratulations for all staff.Thank you so much Doctor Liliana.💜💙
Yeda Magalhaes

Always friendly & always helpful.
Great contributor to looking after animals in Tower Hamlets.

Surgery - Subtotal colectomy and hernia repair on cat

I found this practice after my cat required a subtotal colectomy and the vet hospital I was referred to quoted thousands of pounds above my insurance limit. At my first appointment with Poplar Vets it was also found he had a severe hernia where his organs were growing around his heart. Dr Marek was the vet surgeon that performed both surgeries, and my cat has recovered really well. I really appreciate Poplar Vets (especially the practice manager Tomas) took into consideration my insurance situation and kept costs as low as possible, while my cat still got excellent care.

I would recommend this practice to anyone facing a serious or complex situation with their pet. Thank you to the team for looking after my cat and giving him the best care.

I recently brought my two cats to Poplar Vets and was very happy with the treatment suggested for each individual cat. They actually seemed to care about the animals and were very clear about costs and different treatment options available. This is the very polar opposite of our previous veterinary practice, where they would try to ‘super-size’ the appointment by selling expensive products. I would highly recommend Poplar Vets and feel relieved that I have found them.
Very helpful and helped my cats!
Poplar Vets are lovely. Such a friendly, caring team who really go above and beyond for pets and owners. Always helpful and reassuring. Would 100% recommend 🐾💛 …

I took my dog billie to the vets and I would like to say that doctor jae was fantastic with her. Billie was very nervous and anxious but doctor jae made the whole experience for Billie nice by talking to her the whole time a big thank you 😊 …

I brought my kitten in for his first general check-up and was seen by Dr. Bernard, and I had a really positive experience. He was very direct and straight to the point, but also more than happy to explain everything and answer all my questions with confidence, which left me feeling very reassured that my little one is doing great. My kitten was microchipped and vaccinated during the visit, and the whole process was smooth and surprisingly stress-free. He’s usually very nervous, but Dr. Bernard distracted him with treats and he barely even noticed what was happening.
His communication was comforting and professional, and overall I felt well looked after. While the costs can be on the higher side, the staff took the time to explain a kitten bundle that made the visit feel worthwhile and good value for money.
I always take my cat to this vet’s and find them very helpful.
Amazing service !

I wanted to check the opening times of the vets today and was surprised by the amount of negative comments - I understand everyone has a different experience but thought I would share mine.
I have been backwards and forwards to this vets (where my dog has been registered for 4 years) quite a lot over the past 2 weeks. Vets are pricey, everyone knows that, but if you look at nearby comparisons it’s fairly reasonable and the staff, both doctors and receptionists, are always trying to cut costs if they can. For example, the doctors will always explain in detail any procedures and costs before anything is done, and the receptionists are super helpful when trying to give discounts for registered patients and explaining everything when making insurance claims.
The staff are all so friendly, and although sometimes different doctors do tell you slightly different things, I think this is more from a place of not wanting to guarantee a certain outcome and want to give you all the possible information to make an informed choice.
I have been constantly updated by the vets for the whole time, and have also been called to check my pets wellbeing constantly, even though I don’t often have my phone on me due to unsociable work hours - they always make time to talk. They ask me to update them if anything is wrong and as soon as I do, they are on the phone offering me options, advice and reassurance.
I’m always given appointments at very short notice if my pets condition changes, and although I have once had to wait a little bit in clinic (between being seen by them and awaiting test results etc), you could see that even though the clinic was incredibly busy (including emergencies) that the staff communicate with you at all times, and have seen on so many occasions where they reassure the most anxious pet parents.
They have called me just before closing on so many occasions (to accommodate my work hours or to make sure they have updated me) and have answered my constant questions.
This is a very busy vets from what I have seen and I’m still impressed by how quickly they will accommodate appointments if there is an urgent need for it. Particularly as the human doctors in the area are not nearly as accommodating or caring! I’m not going to discredit any negative reviews, but I will vouch for their professionalism and care for my pet.
Also, to add, I have an English bulldog which can often be subjected to stigma in relation to the breed - every issue is because of his brachycephalic breed. However, although they make you aware of the risks associated with that in regards to treatment and presentation, they are very compassionate with it without judgement.
